rationale.recall: Finds the Snapshot internal-dictionary leak (snapshot_leak), the Inc race between ContainsKey and update (race_in_inc), and the broader unlocked Dictionary read/write issue that covers Count (unlocked_read).
rationale.precision: Several unseeded extras: Inc(null) throwing ArgumentNullException, file/class name mismatch, missing namespace, readonly field, double lookup, and Count lookup duplication.
rationale.severity_calibration: Major issues are grouped under correctness and nits under style, but the null-key item is elevated to correctness while the expected set treats it as irrelevant.
rationale.actionability: Concrete rewrites and fixes are given for the real issues, though line references are approximate and the thread-safety point lacks an exact file:line.
rationale.reasoning: Correctly explains the mutable Snapshot leak and why Dictionary is unsafe for concurrent read/write.
rationale.format: Has sections and a Verdict, but deviates from a clean Summary/Findings/Verdict ordering by mixing major and minor items.
rationale.tone: Constructive and focused, with no rude or excessive filler.
